title: Contains Duplicate II
statement_short: Given an integer array nums and an integer k, return true if there are two distinct indices i and j in the array such that nums[i] == nums[j] and abs(i - j) <= k.
hint: Array length up to 10^5 requires an O(n) solution using a set of fixed maximum window size k.
why_not: Right: Sliding Window maintains a sliding hash set of at most k elements to detect duplicate values in O(n) time and O(k) space. Not HashMap / Hash Set: Storing all element-index mappings in a full hash map uses O(n) space instead of restricting window size to k. Not Two Pointers: Scanning pointer pairs across non-sorted arrays takes O(n \* k) worst-case time without set lookups. Not Sorting: Sorting elements changes original index positions, requiring extra pair tracking and O(n log n) time.
